messages:
emma: Quick design review: thinking about the schema editor inline hints for tool-calling. Right now the param doc floats and overlaps the signature on narrow viewports. Feels noisy.
devin: agree. suggestion: collapse long param descriptions behind a chevron and show a single-line summary inline. expand in-place on click. keeps the signature compact.
jorge: +1. also can we expose optional vs required visually (dot or tag) and surface that in run-history summaries? e.g., "Run 2 — variant: translate (lang: optional=en)" so folks see when optional params were omitted.
li: UX/copy nit: we use "Preview schema" in the editor but "Open schema" elsewhere. prefer consistent verb. propose "Preview schema" since it implies non-destructive.
emma: keyboard nav note: when cycling function overloads with arrow keys, focus should move into the first editable param. currently it stays on the overload selector which is annoying for power users.
devin: we can focus the first param after debounce so we don't surprise users during quick arrow navigation. also add an aria-live brief announcement like "Selected signature 2 of 4" for screen reader feedback.
jorge: run history grouping idea: group runs by session and show a compact summary row that expands into full structured output. saves vertical space for lengthy experiments.
li: accessibility: ensure the group header is focusable and has a clear affordance for expand/collapse and a descriptive label "Show 5 runs from session 2026-03-01".
emma: copy tweak: change the action label from "Copy to prompt" -> "Copy parameters". shorter, clearer, and matches the telemetry event naming. add aria-describedby on the button to explain what it copies.
devin: small dev note: schema editor stores example payloads in local state; if we collapse descriptions we should still surface the example JSON in a dedicated pane to avoid losing context.
jorge: design asked for a micro-interaction: on collapse/expand animate height and fade param description to keep spatial context. small and delightful.
li: i18n heads-up: some languages expand the signature width drastically. please keep the single-line summary short and add an ellipsis with full text on hover.
emma: can someone open a ticket combining these: schema hint collapse, keyboard focus after overload switch, run history session grouping, copy label change, and aria-live announcements? i'll include a quick mock.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-5120 "Playground: schema hints, overload focus, run-history grouping, and copy microcopy" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-5120
devin: assigning to @jorge for run-history work and @li for a11y + i18n checks. i'll handle the schema editor collapse and the mock.
jorge: will prototype the grouping UI this week and post a short gif.
li: will draft the aria-live phrasings and a small test plan for SR.
emma: thanks all. aim to land in the next sprint. :rocket:
